name: Dixon Technologies (India) Ltd

business.about: Dixon Technologies (India) Limited,  incorporated  in  1993 ,  is  a  Electronic  Manufacturing  Services  (EMS)  company  with operations in the electronic products vertical such as consumer electronics, lighting, home appliance, closed-circuit television cameras  (CCTVs), and mobile  phones. It also  undertakes reverse logistics operations.  Besides, it manufactures security surveillance equipment, wearables & audibles, AC-PCBs. Recently, it has entered a JV with Imagine Marketing Private Limited for designing and manufacturing wireless audio solutions in India. [1]
business.key_points: Business Segments: [1] a) Mobile & EMS Division (90% in FY26 vs 85% in FY25) : [2] [3] [4] The company has emerged as the fastest-growing EMS company by revenue and market capitalisation . It manufactures feature phones, smartphones, IT hardware, Telecom, hearables & wearables. Its key client in this segment includes Samsung. b) Consumer Electronics & Appliances (6% in FY26 vs 9% in FY25): [5] [5] [4] The company offers LED TVs (32-98 inches), Smart TVs, Monitors, IFPD Commercial displays, Digital signage PCB & LCM panel assembly, and LED Bar Injection moulding. It is the largest Original Design Manufacturing (OEM & ODM) company in India , and has a 37% share in outsourced manufacturing . Its clients include Xiaomi, Samsung, Hisense, Panasonic, Acer, Toshiba, BPL, Lloyd, VU, Motorola, etc. c) Home Appliances (3% in FY26 vs 4% in FY25): [6] [4] The company is an ODM/OEM in India, manufacturing Semi-Automatic Washing Machines (SAWM) and Fully Automatic Top Load (FATL) models for both domestic and global markets, holding about 35% market share in SAWM and around 15% in the FATL segment .
